tech_verified.frontend: Spring MVC server-rendered Thymeleaf templates + HTML/CSS + Vanilla JavaScript Fetch API
tech_verified.auth: Cookie JWT HttpOnly; apiFetch adds X-Requested-With; raw fetch mutation omissions are gaps

ui_actions.name: Tra cứu, tìm kiếm và lọc mỹ phẩm
ui_actions.notes: SSR: ProductPageController.productList calls productService.searchAndFilter(keyword, brandId, categoryId, skinType, concern, priceRange, sortBy). Không fetch API public catalog trên storefront. page parameter chỉ đưa vào Model, không paginate.

ui_actions.name: Xem chi tiết mỹ phẩm
ui_actions.notes: SSR productService.getById; selected SKU updates price and code locally. Related products actually same category OR brand, limit 4; no BeautyProfile personalization.

ui_actions.name: Xem thương hiệu
ui_actions.notes: HomeController loads brandService.getAll; links filter catalog by brandId.

ui_actions.name: Xem hệ thống cửa hàng
ui_actions.notes: HomeController loads storeService.getAll; cards show province/name/address/phone/hours. Không map/booking.

ui_actions.name: Kiểm tra còn hàng theo cửa hàng
ui_actions.notes: Modal per selectedSkuId displays storeName/address/phone/inStock/availableStock. Không giữ hàng.

ui_actions.name: Đăng ký khách hàng
ui_actions.notes: UI sends displayName rather than required RegisterRequest.fullName -> @Valid returns 400 before account creation. Even with corrected field, register responds 201 without JWT cookie and UI falsely says auto login without invoking login.

ui_actions.name: Đăng nhập
ui_actions.notes: Identifier/password; apiFetch attaches X-Requested-With and backend login issues JWT cookie. UI checks res.isEmployee, but LoginResponse has accountType/redirectUrl and no isEmployee; UI ignores backend redirectUrl, so default employee login navigates / rather than /admin (unless request redirect parameter itself /admin). Remember checkbox unread.

ui_actions.name: Đăng xuất
ui_actions.notes: LUNEA.logout POST with credentials/include header then full GET /logout; AuthPageController evicts JWT cookie/clears context/session.

ui_actions.name: Đặt lại mật khẩu
ui_actions.notes: Modal sends emailOrPhone/newPassword, confirm local. Raw fetch omits X-Requested-With, filter rejects 403. Backend does not use Email/OTP actor.

ui_actions.name: Xem hồ sơ khách hàng
ui_actions.notes: SSR calls customerService.getProfile and getAddresses; displays loyaltyPoints only (no redemption/accrual UI). Controller falls back customerId=1 when principal ID missing.

ui_actions.name: Cập nhật hồ sơ
ui_actions.notes: Full name/phone/dob/gender; email disabled, no password-change form.

ui_actions.name: Xem sổ địa chỉ
ui_actions.notes: Initial SSR addresses; edit/default actions fetch actual list.

ui_actions.name: Thêm địa chỉ nhận hàng
ui_actions.notes: Recipient/phone/province/district/ward/detail/default from modal. Static locations includes 5 provinces but UI select only HCM/HN/DN.

ui_actions.name: Cập nhật địa chỉ nhận hàng
ui_actions.notes: Edit fetch only fills recipient/phone/detail/default; province/district/ward not prefilled from existing record, can save stale controls.

ui_actions.name: Đặt địa chỉ mặc định
ui_actions.notes: Fetch list, set target.isDefault=true, submit whole target. No dedicated endpoint.

ui_actions.name: Xóa địa chỉ nhận hàng
ui_actions.notes: Confirmation; UI hides delete for default address, non-default card removed on success.

ui_actions.name: Xem sản phẩm yêu thích
ui_actions.notes: SSR wishListService.getWishList; card links to product detail, no move-to-cart operation.

ui_actions.name: Lưu sản phẩm yêu thích
ui_actions.notes: toggleWishlist raw fetch only Content-Type, lacks X-Requested-With. Blocked by filter with cookie JWT. Hearts not initialized from server wishlist state.

ui_actions.name: Bỏ sản phẩm yêu thích
ui_actions.notes: Both toggleWishlist and removeWishlistItem raw fetch omit X-Requested-With -> 403.

ui_actions.name: Xem giỏ hàng
ui_actions.notes: SSR cartService.getCart; JS cart badge separately fetches /api/cart.

ui_actions.name: Thêm mỹ phẩm vào giỏ
ui_actions.notes: Requires SKU selection; quantity 1..99; JSON skuId/quantity; updates badge. Backend actual stock checks delegated commerce.

ui_actions.name: Thay đổi số lượng trong giỏ
ui_actions.notes: updateQty calls API; response code expects itemSubtotal/cartSubtotal although CartResponse has items/subtotal/totalItems, therefore money stale until reload. +/- onclick embeds SSR quantity and repeats same target across clicks.

ui_actions.name: Xóa mặt hàng khỏi giỏ
ui_actions.notes: Confirm then reload. newQty<1 also routes to remove.

ui_actions.name: Chuẩn bị đặt hàng
ui_actions.notes: SSR cart+saved addresses+stores loaded; UI selects existing address or new. Only standard delivery and COD. No store selection or deliveryMethod payload.

ui_actions.name: Áp dụng voucher khi đặt hàng
ui_actions.notes: Payload only voucherCode. Uses preview.discountAmount/shippingFee. On every API error, hardcoded client discount for LUNEA10/GIAM50K/FREESHIP claims success regardless server validity.

ui_actions.name: Đặt hàng thanh toán khi nhận
ui_actions.notes: Sends recipientName/Phone, province/district/ward, shippingAddress, note, COD, voucherCode, customerAddressId. Does not send storeId/deliveryMethod/expectedTotal. Backend assigned store, response orderCode -> success page.

ui_actions.name: Xem xác nhận đặt hàng
ui_actions.notes: SSR getByOrderCode; page displays orderCode/store/recipient/total. Status text fixed Chờ xác nhận and fallback totals when no order. Controller has no owner check here (commerce/security root cross-check).

ui_actions.name: Xem và lọc đơn hàng của tôi
ui_actions.notes: SSR getByCustomer; status filtering local DOM including PENDING/CONFIRMED/PREPARING/SHIPPING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED.

ui_actions.name: Xem chi tiết và tiến độ đơn
ui_actions.notes: SSR getById+getByOrder; checks customer owner only when principal and non-null customerId/order.customerId. Shows snapshot, delivery, totals, stepper, return records.

ui_actions.name: Hủy đơn hàng của tôi
ui_actions.notes: UI and OrderServiceImpl.cancelOrder both allow cancellation only PENDING. Confirmation and reload; staff cancellation differs (PENDING/CONFIRMED/PREPARING status workflow).

ui_actions.name: Gửi yêu cầu trả hàng
ui_actions.notes: UI visible only COMPLETED and no prior request. Check subset order items; quantity hidden full purchased qty, no partial-quantity editing. Sends orderId/reason/description/items. Backend customer required association missing per commerce analysis.

ui_actions.name: Theo dõi yêu cầu trả hàng
ui_actions.notes: SSR returnService.getByOrder presents statuses/reason on same detail; no cancel/withdraw return UI.

ui_actions.name: Xem tổng quan vận hành
ui_actions.notes: KPI computed in browser from live order list: sum totalAmount of COMPLETED, pending, preparing+shipping, recent first six orders. No date filter/time series/top-selling. Low stock fetched separately.

ui_actions.name: Xem cảnh báo tồn thấp
ui_actions.notes: Shows count/all and first five. With all-store dashboard, chooses options[1] (first store), no chain aggregation.

ui_actions.name: Tra cứu đơn hàng trong phạm vi cửa hàng
ui_actions.notes: Branch selector from StoreScope; local status/code/name/phone filters. Admin any/all branches, other employee accessibleStores only.

ui_actions.name: Xem đơn hàng cần xử lý
ui_actions.notes: AJAX render snapshots/prices/address/stepper; data-order-id from page Model.

ui_actions.name: Xác nhận đơn hàng
ui_actions.notes: State-dependent action; quick confirm in orders table; confirmation for detail. Header wrapper correct. No role/permission-specific hide beyond status; actual backend authorization must decide.

ui_actions.name: Chuyển đơn sang chuẩn bị hàng
ui_actions.notes: State-dependent action; quick confirm in orders table; confirmation for detail. Header wrapper correct. No role/permission-specific hide beyond status; actual backend authorization must decide.

ui_actions.name: Xác nhận bắt đầu giao hàng
ui_actions.notes: State-dependent action; quick confirm in orders table; confirmation for detail. Header wrapper correct. No role/permission-specific hide beyond status; actual backend authorization must decide.

ui_actions.name: Xác nhận giao hàng và thu tiền COD
ui_actions.notes: State-dependent action; quick confirm in orders table; confirmation for detail. Header wrapper correct. No role/permission-specific hide beyond status; actual backend authorization must decide.

ui_actions.name: Hủy đơn trước khi giao
ui_actions.notes: State-dependent action; quick confirm in orders table; confirmation for detail. Header wrapper correct. No role/permission-specific hide beyond status; actual backend authorization must decide.

ui_actions.name: Xem yêu cầu trả hàng của đơn
ui_actions.notes: Displays first return only (returns[0]), hidden card if none.

ui_actions.name: Chấp thuận yêu cầu trả hàng
ui_actions.notes: Buttons only for REQUESTED first return; no complete/restock button.

ui_actions.name: Từ chối yêu cầu trả hàng
ui_actions.notes: Buttons only for REQUESTED first return; no complete/restock button.

ui_actions.name: Tra cứu tồn kho cửa hàng
ui_actions.notes: SKU/name local filter; actual/held/available/minimum/status + sums KPI. Accessible branch options; query storeId in dashboard link ignored in initialization.

ui_actions.name: Điều chỉnh tồn thực tế
ui_actions.notes: NewQuantity >= held UI enforced; required reason preset/custom. Sends storeId/skuId/newQuantity/reason. Reasons mentioning purchase/transfer only update one stock record, not actual purchase/transfer processes.

ui_actions.name: Tra cứu sản phẩm và SKU toàn chuỗi
ui_actions.notes: Fetch public reads, client filter name/brand/category/origin, KPI total products/SKUs/featured/ACTIVE, show prices/stock/status/link storefront. No editing actions/forms/modal.

ui_actions.name: Đổi giao diện sáng tối
ui_actions.notes: localStorage lunea-theme + DOM data-theme. UI convenience, exclude main business use cases.

ui_only.reason: Checkbox has no id/name and handleLogin never reads/sends it; no refresh token.

ui_only.name: Xem đánh giá khách hàng trên chi tiết sản phẩm
ui_only.reason: Static single testimonial, no Review API fetch/create form; do not mark review UI integrated.

ui_only.name: Xem voucher của tôi
ui_only.reason: Toast hardcoded 3 vouchers or no vouchers, no fetch.

ui_only.name: Xem thông báo
ui_only.reason: Only toast Không có thông báo mới.

ui_only.name: Cài đặt tài khoản
ui_only.reason: Only toast tính năng đang hoàn thiện.

ui_only.name: Trang khuyến mãi
ui_only.reason: Link to /products?concern=Trị+Mụn, not real promotion/voucher catalogue.

ui_only.reason: Hardcoded codes after API error, may disagree persisted checkout.

ui_only.reason: Static informational toast; not policy administration or backend workflow.

backend_without_ui.evidence: No page route, form or fetch targets for corresponding /api/customers/*/beauty-profile and /api/employees endpoints.

features: SKU mutation if backend service exists

backend_without_ui.evidence: admin/products.html only GET fetches. Need operations agent verify which service operations exposed as endpoints; never infer missing APIs from design.
Only public /stores list; no back-office route/fetch for /api/stores mutation or /api/stock-transfers.
No /api/reviews calls, product review tab static.
Admin UI only first per-order return, approve/reject; no COMPLETED button.
DELETE /api/cart exists; no clear button/API call.
No voucher admin route/fetch; operations agent verifies whether backend exposed at all.

gaps.detail: Wishlist POST/DELETE and password reset POST raw fetch lack X-Requested-With, rejected by XRequestedWithFilter. No browser bearer header because JWT cookie is HttpOnly.
POST register UI sends displayName; DTO requires nonblank fullName with no JSON alias -> HTTP 400. Also missing cookie/login step, so auto-login promise is unimplemented.
CartResponse.subtotal/items mismatch UI itemSubtotal/cartSubtotal; money/count header do not update after PUT; plus/minus target uses initial SSR quantity.
Existing recipient/phone/detail/default filled; province/district/ward not copied. Save submits current modal selection.
Checkout downloads JSON then ignores contents, hardcodes 3 provinces/3 unrelated wards, no district dropdown; hidden fields and address defaults can diverge visible selects.
Product page parameter only Model; no pagination controls or paging passed to searchAndFilter.
All-store orders aggregate but lowStockStoreId falls back first branch; no chain-wide stock report.
Dashboard links /admin/inventory?storeId=X but inventory initialization never reads URL query; default primaryStoreId used.

Sidebar/orders/inventory controls never use sec:authorize/permission gating; only isEmployee/isCustomer header and status/StoreScope filtering. Do not interpret visible controls as granted authorization.
Only full purchased quantity per selected item; first-return admin display, no restock/completion button; create backend persistence defect verified commerce agent.
order-success page looks up arbitrary orderCode without owner check. AccountPageController order-detail only conditional ownership; do not infer ownership from protected route alone.
Login UI checks res.isEmployee which LoginResponse never contains, and ignores response.redirectUrl. Employee default login lands storefront / instead of /admin; cookie authentication still succeeds.

designs_not_implemented.status: Design-only unless integration source is found by backend agents
designs_not_implemented.actual: No calls in frontend to payment/shipping/Maps/upload/mail; CDN fonts/icons/GSAP and remote product images are presentation dependencies, not business actors.
ProductPageController.relatedProducts simple category OR brand filtering; no beauty-profile UI.

designs_not_implemented.feature: Store pickup / staff reassignment / advanced reporting
designs_not_implemented.actual: Checkout COD/home-delivery only; no assignment control; dashboard browser sums order list only.

designs_not_implemented.feature: Dynamic permission menus and product pagination in local plan
designs_not_implemented.actual: Sidebar unconditional; no pagination; docs checklist is not proof.
Base/Updated planned session+CSRF and ModelMapper/MapStruct; v2 planned JWT; source confirms JWT and Thymeleaf independently.

designs_not_implemented.feature: Khách tự hủy đơn ở CONFIRMED/PREPARING
designs_not_implemented.status: Historical design only; actual PENDING cancellation
designs_not_implemented.actual: UI shows PENDING only and OrderServiceImpl.cancelOrder enforces PENDING.

notes: Implemented_ui=true means a control/flow is coded, not that backend succeeds or authorization is correct. integration_status is source-inspection recommendation, runtime not exercised here.
All endpoint/operations source implementations verified by separate backend agents; frontend routes and calls were read directly.
No include/extend recommendation from UI navigation, auth preconditions, CRUD or sequential status buttons alone.
